{{Quote|Your chips say that you boys are from Andooweel. Is that correct?|An Imperial officer, to Rebel infiltrators|<ref name="YITAN" />}}
'''Andooweel''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Andooweel system/Legends|Andooweel system]] of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], located on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].

==History==
{{Quote|A great darkness is here.''"<br>"''Nothing my blaster can't light up. Chewie, put her down over there. Luke, Leia, and I are going to explore the surface.|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo|<ref name="CNE" />}}
Discovered during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], Andooweel was an impoverished world with small pockets of industrial and agricultural [[district]]s, both of which were unsuccessful. At some point, several [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations were begun; though nothing of value was ever uncovered.<ref name="TEA" /> Like other [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] worlds such as [[C-Foroon]], Andooweel was said to be a refuge for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="ANH:TLOLS">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>

Citizens of Andooweel were among recruits to the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Some had chosen to join the Imperial Army instead of going to jail for petty theft and illegal [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] racing, and were to be trained on the planet [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]] at [[Training Camp IMIIF-138]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents successfully infiltrated the base posing as recruits hailing from Andooweel to retrieve [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts from [[Nonessential Equipment Storage and Disposal Facility 456]] on Sirpar.<ref name="YITAN" />

The former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] and [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophet of the Dark Side]] [[Cronal]] established himself as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]<ref name="CNE" /> on Andooweel, circa [[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]].<ref name="The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> Obsessed with creating art, he hoped to use advanced [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] to overthrow both the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], creating an "Empire of art." He was eventually killed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="CNE" />
